target.role: Senior Manager Corporate Treasury Performance Management ALM

summary: Senior Manager, Corporate Treasury Performance Management, ALM candidate bringing ~7 years across asset-liability management, interest rate risk, and executive balance-sheet reporting. Holds delegated sign-off authority at Moody's Analytics on valuation, sensitivity, and ALM outputs for institutional portfolios of $5-25bn per engagement, reviewing rate-shock sensitivities and hedge-output consistency before release. Led design of a multi-scenario cash-flow and balance-sheet projection engine spanning base, stress, and reverse-stress paths, and prepares interest-rate exposure and balance-sheet sensitivity analysis for senior stakeholders. CFA charterholder with dual MSc degrees.
core_skills: Hedging Analysis - Interest Rate, Inflation, Currency

sections.heading: Interest Rate Risk & Hedging Analysis
bullets: Holds delegated sign-off authority on valuation, sensitivity, and ALM outputs for multi-asset institutional portfolios of $5-25bn per engagement (~$50bn+ cumulative), independently reviewing curve construction, spread calibration, and cross-asset interactions prior to release.
Oversees interest rate risk and duration analysis under parallel and non-parallel rate shocks, aligned with IRRBB-style standards analogous to OSFI B-12 and Basel Committee frameworks.
Validates derivatives pricing outputs across rates, FX, and inflation, confirming consistency of hedging sensitivities and scenario impacts at portfolio-level ALM aggregates.

sections.heading: Balance Sheet Projection, Forecasting & Decision Support
bullets: Led design and implementation of an enterprise multi-asset cash-flow projection engine supporting base, stress, and reverse-stress scenarios, delivering forward-looking balance sheet and liquidity visibility across ALM horizons.
Architected configurable time-bucketed gap analytics (T+1 through multi-year) enabling funding optimization, refinancing risk assessment, and asset-allocation decisions.

Embedded behavioural cash-flow assumptions, prepayment logic, and macro stress overlays into projection scenarios, and reviewed aggregation logic converting security-level exposures into portfolio-level metrics feeding downstream ALM processes.

sections.heading: Stakeholder Reporting, Governance & Process Streamlining
bullets: Prepares analytical summaries for senior stakeholders and clients' Heads of Risk covering interest rate exposure, scenario impacts, and balance sheet sensitivities, translating quantitative output into committee-ready narratives.

Re-engineered manual spreadsheet workflows into scalable Python analytics pipelines with embedded logging, validation, and auditability controls; serves on the model governance committee for client-delivered analytics.

Built agentic AI development workflows (Claude Code, Cursor IDE) automating code generation, validation scaffolding, and documentation, cutting development cycle time an estimated 30-40% on comparable modules.

Led onboarding for U.S. and Canadian pension funds, asset managers, and consulting firms onto PFaroe DB (risk & ALM analytics) and PFaroe PM, advising on asset, liability, and ALM configurations and validating model outputs post-deployment.
Delivered IFRS 17 and IFRS 9 transformation projects for Canadian and international insurance clients, aligning accounting requirements with system implementation and financial reporting frameworks.
Coordinated actuarial, finance, IT, risk, and program-management teams on milestone delivery, governance documentation, and regulatory-readiness processes.
Delivered ALM studies for Canadian and international pension funds and institutional investors, analyzing funding ratios, duration mismatch, and long-term balance sheet risk exposures.
Performed cash flow, liquidity, and hedging analysis across interest rate, inflation, and currency risk for international institutional clients.
Built and interpreted stochastic economic scenario generators assessing interest rate risk and funding volatility under base-case and stressed environments.
Presented ALM study findings and strategic asset allocation recommendations on-site to investment committees at Canadian pension-fund clients.

education: MSc, Chemical Engineering (Full Scholarship) - Western University, 2016
